policy.evidenceBoundary: Awards verify recognition; official pages verify declared medium or interaction. Visual-language deductions are explicitly marked as analysis.
policy.awwwardsBoundary: Awwwards cases support browser presentation, camera and interaction precedents only; they do not prove sustained systemic gameplay or production feasibility.
policy.generationBoundary: No Sea of Thousand Names scene concept image is generated in this run.

sources.title: BAFTA Games - Artistic Achievement
sources.verified: The archive lists Journey (2013), Lumino City (2015), Return of the Obra Dinn (2019), Hades (2021), TUNIC (2023) as winners and Harold Halibut (2025) as a nominee.

sources.title: Return of the Obra Dinn
sources.verified: The official page describes the game as an insurance adventure with minimal colour and lists major art and game awards.

sources.title: Lucas Pope on Return of the Obra Dinn's art style
sources.verified: Lucas Pope discusses the one-bit, two-colour presentation, 800 by 450 working image, geometric outlines and controlled dithering for legibility.

sources.title: Pentiment
sources.verified: The official page describes a living illustrated world inspired by illuminated manuscripts and woodcuts.

sources.title: Deep Dive: The art of Pentiment
sources.verified: Art director Hannah Kennedy explains that historical art was tied to the game's identity and that the team changed an initially revision-heavy hand-drawn pipeline.

sources.title: Journey - Matt Nava
sources.verified: Matt Nava documents visual design, texture painting, lighting and colour scripting work on Journey.

sources.title: Awaken your wanderlust with open-world adventure Sable
sources.verified: Creative director Gregorios Kythreotis connects masks, exploration and self-discovery; the page provides official visual examples.

sources.title: Okami Wii Manual
sources.verified: The manual describes a watercolour-ink presentation and the Celestial Brush as a way to alter the world.

sources.title: Harold Halibut Press Kit
sources.verified: The press kit documents physically handmade sets and puppets using metal, textiles, wood and clay, and lists visual-art award recognition.

sources.title: British Academy Games Awards 2015 winners release
sources.verified: BAFTA identifies Lumino City as a puzzle adventure handmade in card and paper and the 2015 Artistic Achievement winner.

sources.title: TUNIC
sources.verified: The official site describes an isometric action game about exploring lost legends and ancient powers.

sources.title: Supergiant Games Team
sources.verified: The official team page identifies Jen Zee and the studio's visual-art contributors.

sources.title: Bruno Simon Portfolio
sources.verified: Awwwards lists the portfolio as Site of the Day, records a Developer Award score, identifies Three.js, and highlights its 3D game project navigation.

sources.title: My Little Storybook
sources.verified: Awwwards lists the project as Site of the Day and identifies WebGL, Three.js, GSAP, Lottie and Blender among its technologies.

sources.title: A Short Journey
sources.verified: Awwwards lists the project as Site of the Day and tags it for WebGL, art, illustration, music and animation.

sources.title: ACNPL\WGL
sources.verified: Awwwards lists the real-time Canvas/WebGL graphic playground as Site of the Day.

sources.title: Step into ARCANE's Immersive World with This Guide to the Making of Season Two
sources.verified: Netflix interviews Fortiche leads, documents concept-to-final iteration, environment and character design, matte painting, FX, texture and compositing work, and reports a peak creative team of about 450 artists.

sources.title: Arcane
sources.verified: Netflix provides official series stills, trailers and behind-the-scenes links for visual comparison.

imageDisplayPolicy.fallback: Every image links to its source page; the written analysis remains usable if a remote host blocks embedding.
imageDisplayPolicy.copyrightBoundary: Images are shown only as attributed research references. No image is an approved game asset or a composition template.

imageReferences.observation: Two-colour value structure, silhouette-first staging and controlled dithering preserve spatial evidence without material realism.
Flattened depth, manuscript framing, deliberate contour language and typography make history and social identity visible.
Ink contour, paper-like space and colour restoration are part of the world transformation rather than surface decoration.
Clean silhouettes, outlined forms and broad colour fields keep a masked figure readable against monumental distance.
A tiny high-contrast traveler, a dominant destination and large quiet colour masses create pilgrimage scale with minimal clutter.
Clay faces, textile clothing, imperfect surfaces and photographed miniature lighting make characters feel physically present.
Paper construction, practical light and depth-of-field turn the level into a legible physical diorama.
Graphic character silhouettes, controlled accents and portrait-scale expression carry mythic identity more than environmental realism.
Fixed isometric composition, compact landmarks and restrained geometry make routes and interactable thresholds readable.
A single toy-like navigation metaphor replaces conventional web navigation and makes interaction immediately visible.
Illustration, shallow 3D and interface motion are composed as one browser-native storytelling surface.
A narrow palette and screen-space illustration keep the visual premise readable during a short interactive sequence.

imageReferences.observation: Painterly value grouping, selective hard edges and atmosphere create cinematic depth without photoreal surface uniformity.
